# Keybindings

## Frame keys

These work from anywhere in the the-deaner window (sidebar or terminal). They are bound in the-deaner's outer tmux frame and can be changed under `[keys]` in `config.toml`.

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| `Alt-/` | Open this searchable shortcut cheat sheet |
| `Alt-s` | Move focus between the sidebar and the terminal |
| `Alt-e` | Hide / show the sidebar |

You can also click a sidebar row to open it, scroll the list with the wheel, and drag the border between the sidebar and the terminal to resize. The width is remembered.

## Sidebar keys

These work while the sidebar has focus.

### Navigate

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| `j` / `↓` | Move down |
| `k` / `↑` | Move up |
| `g` / `Home` | Jump to top |
| `G` / `End` | Jump to bottom |
| `Ctrl-d` | Half a page down |
| `Ctrl-u` | Half a page up |
| `Enter` | Open workspace in the terminal (starts or unparks it) |
| `n` | Go to next agent needing you |
| `v` | Peek at an agent's output |
| `Space` | Collapse / expand repo |
| `/` | Filter by repo or branch (Esc clears) |

### Workspaces

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| `w` | New worktree + session for a branch |
| `t` | New tab (agent, editor, shell) |
| `a` | Open a project: browse folders, add and start it |
| `x` | Archive worktree / forget repo (asks first) |
| `P` | Park: save and stop the session |
| `S` | Save a snapshot now |

### Pins

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| `p` | Pin / unpin repo |
| `K` | Move pinned repo up |
| `J` | Move pinned repo down |

### Other

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| `r` | Refresh now |
| `?` | Show / hide this help |
| `b` | Make toast |
| `q` | Detach: all keeps running, `the-deaner` comes back (quits when standalone) |

### In prompts and pickers

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| `Enter` | Confirm |
| `Esc` | Cancel |
| `j` / `k` / `↑` / `↓` | Move in a picker |
| `1`–`9` | Pick an item directly |
| `y` / `n` | Answer a confirmation |
